verdicts.observation: The source damage_types.lua:909 is one of the death_message entries for the blight damage type. PartyDeath.lua:71,107 picks one at random and puts it in the 'was %s to death by %s' template, so the source means the victim was weakened/debilitated by noxious blight before falling. The target, 死前吸入过多剧毒瘴气 ('inhaled too much toxic miasma before dying'), rewrites both 'debilitated' and 'blight' as inhaling a poisonous gas (瘴气). Blight is corruption/withering damage, not a gas, so the damage-type meaning is misrepresented.

The source agility.lua:69-71 is the Agile Defense damage log. The %d is lastdam-dam, the amount of damage the shield deflected and removed. The target, (%d 敏捷防御), replaces 'deflected' with what reads like the talent name ('Agile Defense'), so it no longer says the number is damage deflected/reduced and the log is ambiguous. It should keep the meaning 'N deflected' (for example, 偏斜 %d).

The source blighted-ruins.lua:27 is a single lore paragraph with no line breaks. The target adds a '\n\t' (newline plus tab) after the second sentence (这令我很不悦。). That is a newline/whitespace change with no source counterpart and will show a stray line break and tab in the lore text.

This is the Solipsist locked_desc (psionic.lua:139). Error 1: the source says the world is the single collective dream of the people who live in it, but the target says 世界由许多个梦境组成 (the world is made of many separate dreams), which contradicts the next line (141) about 'the collective vision of those that experience it'. Error 2: 'you'll unlock the potential of your dreams' is rewritten as 打开通往梦境之门 ('open the door to the dream world'). That drops the meaning of unlocking the potential of your dreams, which matters because this line is the unlock hint for the class.

The target drops the qualifier 'for each turn you spend within its area'. Per damage_types.lua:3935-3946, the STATIC_NET projector gives the caster STATIC_CHARGE (power=weapon) every turn they stand in the net, and mental.lua:2812-2813 on_merge adds power=new+old. The bonus therefore stacks %0.1f for each turn spent in the net. The target, 让你的下一次攻击造成额外 %0.1f 的闪电伤害, reads as a flat %0.1f total, which understates how the bonus scales.
